processors.description: Build content from full AuditRecord envelope and payload

dql.script:
fieldsAdd content = concat(
  "{",
  "\"audit_event_id\":\"", coalesce(audit_event_id, ""), "\",",
  "\"timestamp\":\"", toString(timestamp), "\",",
  "\"schema_version\":\"", coalesce(schema_version, ""), "\",",
  "\"category\":\"", coalesce(category, ""), "\",",
  "\"decision\":\"", coalesce(decision, ""), "\",",
  "\"action_type\":\"", coalesce(action_type, ""), "\",",
  "\"enforcement_mode\":\"", coalesce(enforcement_mode, ""), "\",",
  "\"username\":\"", coalesce(username, ""), "\",",
  "\"user_email\":\"", coalesce(user_email, ""), "\",",
  "\"auth_method\":\"", coalesce(auth_method, ""), "\",",
  "\"oauth_client_id\":\"", coalesce(oauth_client_id, ""), "\",",
  "\"agent\":\"", coalesce(agent, ""), "\",",
  "\"org_id\":\"", coalesce(org_id, ""), "\",",
  "\"org_name\":\"", coalesce(org_name, ""), "\",",
  "\"audit_session_id\":\"", coalesce(audit_session_id, ""), "\",",
  "\"sandbox_id\":\"", coalesce(sandbox_id, ""), "\",",
  "\"resource_id\":\"", coalesce(resource_id, ""), "\",",
  "\"policy_id\":\"", coalesce(policy_id, ""), "\",",
  "\"policy_rule\":\"", coalesce(policy_rule, ""), "\",",
  "\"policy_name\":\"", coalesce(policy_name, ""), "\",",
  "\"policy_type\":\"", coalesce(policy_type, ""), "\",",
  "\"policy_source\":\"", coalesce(policy_source, ""), "\",",
  "\"policy_version\":\"", coalesce(policy_version, ""), "\",",
  "\"os\":\"", coalesce(os, ""), "\",",
  "\"app_version\":\"", coalesce(app_version, ""), "\",",
  "\"client_name\":\"", coalesce(client_name, ""), "\",",
  "\"hostname\":\"", coalesce(hostname, ""), "\",",
  "\"payload\":", coalesce(tool_invocation, resource_read, server_registration, session, prompt, network_egress, filesystem_mount, policy_sync, tool_execution, resource_read_execution, network_egress_execution, filesystem_mount_execution, prompt_execution, pii_detection, c_score_report, policy_action, "null"),
  "}")

processors.description: Set log.source, host.name, and docker.audit.* mapped attributes

dql.script:
fieldsAdd log.source = "docker-sandbox-auditlogs"
| fieldsAdd host.name = hostname
| fieldsAdd docker.audit.org_id = org_id
| fieldsAdd docker.audit.session_id = audit_session_id
| fieldsAdd docker.audit.category = category
| fieldsAdd docker.audit.action_type = action_type
| fieldsAdd docker.audit.decision = decision
| fieldsAdd docker.audit.enforcement_mode = enforcement_mode

parse c_score_report, "JSON:cs"
| fieldsAdd docker.audit.cscore_band = cs[band]
| fieldsRemove cs
